meaning: admittedly/it is true that ~, but ~ (concessive emphasis)

exercises.example_sentence: この製品は見た目こそ地味だが、性能は抜群だ。
exercises.translation: This product may look plain, but its performance is outstanding.
wrong_choice_explanations: さえ means 'even X', marking an extreme case on top of others. 見た目さえ地味だが implies other things are plain and even the looks are too, which undercuts the praise for performance; こそ concedes the plain looks to set up 性能は抜群だ.
ばかり means 'only X, nothing but X'. 見た目ばかり地味だが is a stretch — ばかり suits repeated or habitual things, not a single attribute — and it doesn't give the 'admittedly X, but Y' concession that こそ〜が builds.

も means 'X too, also'. 見た目も地味だが presupposes something else about the product is also plain, but the sentence names nothing; こそ concedes the plain looks alone and contrasts them with outstanding performance.
exercises.hiragana_full: このせいひんはみためこそじみだが、せいのうはばつぐんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: この製品は見た目こそ地味だが、性能は文句なしだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: このせいひんはみためこそじみだが、せいのうはもんくなしだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 外見は地味かもしれないが、性能に関しては群を抜いている。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: がいけんはじみかもしれないが、せいのうにかんしてはぐんをぬいている。

exercises.example_sentence: 彼は体こそ小柄だが、その粘り強さは誰にも負けない。
exercises.translation: Small in build he may be, but in tenacity he yields to no one.
wrong_choice_explanations: さえ means 'even X', adding an extreme case. 体さえ小柄だが would imply other things about him are small too, and even his body is — which makes no sense; こそ concedes his small build in order to praise his tenacity.
すら means 'even X', a written equivalent of さえ. 体すら小柄だが stacks smallness on other unspecified shortcomings and doesn't set up a contrast; こそ〜が admits the small build, then turns to tenacity.
まで means 'even as far as X', extending a list. 体まで小柄だが implies he is small in other ways and his body too, which clashes with praising his tenacity; こそ concedes one point to contrast it with another.
exercises.hiragana_full: かれはからだこそこがらだが、そのねばりづよさはだれにもまけない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 彼は体こそ小柄だが、粘り強さにかけては誰にも引けを取らない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かれはからだこそこがらだが、ねばりづよさにかけてはだれにもひけをとらない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 小柄ではあるものの、彼の粘り強さは並外れている。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: こがらではあるものの、かれのねばりづよさはなみはずれている。

exercises.example_sentence: あの人は口こそ悪いけど、根はやさしくて面倒見がいいんだよ。
exercises.translation: That person may have a sharp tongue, but at heart they're kind and take good care of others. (casual)
wrong_choice_explanations: ばかり means 'only X'. 口ばかり悪いけど、根はやさしい ('only his tongue is rough') is natural Japanese and very close in meaning; こそ is the keyed form because it admits the sharp tongue as a concession before praising his kindness.
さえ means 'even X'. 口さえ悪いけど implies he has other faults and even his tongue is bad, which works against the defence of his character; こそ〜けど concedes the one fault and contrasts it with 根はやさしい.
も means 'X too'. 口も悪いけど implies he has other bad points as well, which weakens the speaker's defence that he is kind at heart; こそ singles out the sharp tongue as the one admitted flaw.
exercises.hiragana_full: あのひとはくちこそわるいけど、ねはやさしくてめんどうみがいいんだよ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: あの人は口こそ悪いけど、根は優しくて頼りになるんだよ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: あのひとはくちこそわるいけど、ねはやさしくてたよりになるんだよ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 言い方はきついけど、本当は優しくて面倒見のいい人なんだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: いいかたはきついけど、ほんとうはやさしくてめんどうみのいいひとなんだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 給料こそ多くないけど、この仕事は本当にやりがいがあって気に入ってるんだ。
exercises.translation: The pay may not be much, but this job is truly rewarding and I really like it. (casual)
wrong_choice_explanations: だけ means 'only X'. 給料だけ多くないけど ('only the pay isn't great') is natural Japanese and close in meaning; こそ is keyed because it frames the low pay as a conceded point that the job's rewards outweigh.
さえ means 'even X'. 給料さえ多くないけど implies other conditions are poor and even the pay is too, which clashes with 本当にやりがいがあって気に入ってる; こそ concedes the low pay alone.
まで means 'even as far as X'. 給料まで多くないけど piles the low pay on top of other complaints, undercutting the speaker's praise of the job; こそ〜けど concedes one drawback and then turns to the positives.
exercises.hiragana_full: きゅうりょうこそおおくないけど、このしごとはほんとうにやりがいがあってきにいってるんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: この仕事は給料こそ多くないけど、やりがいがあって気に入ってるんだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: このしごとはきゅうりょうこそおおくないけど、やりがいがあってきにいってるんだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 稼ぎは大したことないけど、やりがいがあるから今の仕事が好きなんだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かせぎはたいしたことないけど、やりがいがあるからいまのしごとがすきなんだ。

vocab.meaning: to like; to take a liking to

exercises.example_sentence: 彼は若さこそ失ったが、その分、豊かな経験という財産を得た。
exercises.translation: He may have lost his youth, but in return he gained the wealth of rich experience.
wrong_choice_explanations: すら means 'even X'. 若さすら失ったが makes youth the last thing lost after everything else, which turns the sentence into a lament; こそ concedes the loss of youth to contrast it with what he gained.
まで means 'even as far as X'. 若さまで失ったが implies he lost other things and even his youth, which works against その分…得た ('in return he gained'); こそ admits a single loss and sets it against the gain.
も means 'X too'. 若さも失ったが implies he lost something else as well, which the sentence never mentions; こそ singles out youth as the one admitted loss, balanced by the experience he gained.
exercises.hiragana_full: かれはわかさこそうしなったが、そのぶん、ゆたかなけいけんというざいさんをえた。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 彼は若さこそ失ったが、代わりに豊かな経験を手に入れた。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かれはわかさこそうしなったが、かわりにゆたかなけいけんをてにいれた。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 若さは失ったものの、その代償として貴重な経験を得たのだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: わかさはうしなったものの、そのだいしょうとしてきちょうなけいけんをえたのだ。

exercises.example_sentence: わが社は規模こそ小さいが、技術力では大手に引けを取らない。
exercises.translation: Our company may be small in scale, but in technical capability we are second to none of the majors.
wrong_choice_explanations: さえ means 'even X'. 規模さえ小さいが implies the company is lacking in other ways and even its size is small, which undercuts the boast about technical capability; こそ concedes only the small scale.

のみ means 'only X'. 規模のみ小さいが ('only our scale is small') is natural written Japanese and close in meaning; こそ is keyed because it frames the small size as an admitted point set against technical strength.
まで means 'even as far as X'. 規模まで小さいが stacks smallness on other unnamed weaknesses, which clashes with 大手に引けを取らない; こそ concedes the one weakness to set up the boast.
exercises.hiragana_full: わがしゃはきぼこそちいさいが、ぎじゅつりょくではおおてにひけをとらない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 当社は規模こそ小さいが、技術力なら大手にも負けない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: とうしゃはきぼこそちいさいが、ぎじゅつりょくならおおてにもまけない。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 規模は小さいながらも、技術力においては大手にひけを取らない。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: きぼはちいさいながらも、ぎじゅつりょくにおいてはおおてにひけをとらない。

exercises.example_sentence: わがチームはスタートこそ出遅れたが、終盤で見事に逆転した。
exercises.translation: Our team got off to a slow start, to be sure, but in the closing stages we staged a splendid comeback.
wrong_choice_explanations: すら means 'even X'. スタートすら出遅れたが implies everything went badly, even the start, which clashes with the comeback that follows; こそ concedes the slow start to contrast it with 終盤で見事に逆転した.
ばかり means 'only X, nothing but X'. スタートばかり出遅れたが is awkward — ばかり suits repeated actions, not a one-off slow start — and it doesn't build the concession; こそ〜が admits the bad start, then the comeback.
まで means 'even as far as X'. スタートまで出遅れたが implies other things went wrong and even the start did, which makes no sense for a race that ends in victory; こそ concedes the slow start alone.
exercises.hiragana_full: わがちーむはすたーとこそでおくれたが、しゅうばんでみごとにぎゃくてんした。

audio_alternatives.kanji: うちのチームはスタートこそ出遅れたが、後半で鮮やかに逆転してみせた。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: うちのちーむはすたーとこそでおくれたが、こうはんであざやかにぎゃくてんしてみせた。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 立ち上がりは出遅れたものの、終盤で見事に試合をひっくり返した。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: たちあがりはでおくれたものの、しゅうばんでみごとにしあいをひっくりかえした。

vocab.meaning: to get a late start; to fall behind at the outset

exercises.example_sentence: 形こそ違うが、両者が目指すところは本質的に同じだ。
exercises.translation: They may differ in form, but what the two are aiming at is essentially the same.
wrong_choice_explanations: さえ means 'even X'. 形さえ違うが implies they differ in other ways and even in form, which contradicts 本質的に同じ ('essentially the same'); こそ concedes the difference in form to stress the shared aim.
すら means 'even X'. 形すら違うが stacks the difference in form on other differences, which works against the claim that the two are essentially alike; こそ〜が admits only the formal difference.
も means 'X too'. 形も違うが implies they also differ in something else, undermining 目指すところは本質的に同じ; こそ singles out form as the one admitted difference.
exercises.hiragana_full: かたちこそちがうが、りょうしゃがめざすところはほんしつてきにおなじだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 形こそ違うが、二人の目指すものは根本において同じだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かたちこそちがうが、ふたりのめざすものはこんぽんにおいておなじだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: やり方は異なるものの、両者が到達しようとする地点は同じである。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: やりかたはことなるものの、りょうしゃがとうたつしようとするちてんはおなじである。

vocab.meaning: to aim at; to strive for

exercises.example_sentence: その論文は表現こそ穏やかだが、行間には痛烈な批判が込められていた。
exercises.translation: The paper's wording was mild, to be sure, but between the lines a scathing criticism was embedded.
wrong_choice_explanations: まで means 'even as far as X'. 表現まで穏やかだが implies everything about the paper is mild, even the wording, which clashes with the scathing criticism between the lines; こそ concedes only the surface mildness.
さえ means 'even X'. 表現さえ穏やかだが adds the wording to other mild features, which contradicts the hidden harshness; こそ〜が admits the mild wording as a surface point and contrasts it with what lies beneath.
も means 'X too'. 表現も穏やかだが implies something else about the paper is mild as well, blurring the contrast with 痛烈な批判; こそ singles out the wording as the only mild thing.
exercises.hiragana_full: そのろんぶんはひょうげんこそおだやかだが、ぎょうかんにはつうれつなひはんがこめられていた。

audio_alternatives.kanji: その論文は表現こそ穏やかだが、その裏には鋭い批判が潜んでいた。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: そのろんぶんはひょうげんこそおだやかだが、そのうらにはするどいひはんがひそんでいた。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 言葉遣いは穏やかだったものの、行間には激しい批判がにじんでいた。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ことばづかいはおだやかだったものの、ぎょうかんにははげしいひはんがにじんでいた。

exercises.example_sentence: 集まった仲間は数こそ少ないが、いざという時に頼れる者ばかりだ。
exercises.translation: The comrades who gathered may be few in number, but every one of them can be relied on when it counts.
wrong_choice_explanations: さえ means 'even X'. 数さえ少ないが implies the group is lacking in other ways and even its numbers are small, which clashes with 頼れる者ばかり; こそ concedes the small number to praise their reliability.
すら means 'even X'. 数すら少ないが stacks small numbers on other shortcomings, which contradicts the praise that follows; こそ〜が admits the one weakness and then turns to their dependability.
も means 'X too'. 数も少ないが implies something else about them is also lacking, which the sentence never says and which undercuts its praise; こそ singles out the small number as the only conceded weakness.
exercises.hiragana_full: あつまったなかまはかずこそすくないが、いざというときにたよれるものばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 集まった仲間は数こそ少ないが、いずれも頼りになる者ばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: あつまったなかまはかずこそすくないが、いずれもたよりになるものばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 人数は少ないものの、集まったのは皆いざという時に頼れる仲間だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: にんずうはすくないものの、あつまったのはみないざというときにたよれるなかまだ。

vocab.meaning: dependable; able to be relied on
when it really matters; in a pinch
